sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout searched llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety, returned 11 current-week arXiv candidates, and the selected Agent Skill Security row cleared exact arXiv URL, external_id, and title checks in the fresh origin/data checkout.

Main agent read the arXiv abstract, PDF text, lifecycle taxonomy, framework design, empirical tables, appendix skill distribution, prompts, related work, limitations, and third-party skill-eval references.
Article extracted the skill formula S=(M,W,P,T,V), five-stage control loop, retrieval/planner/runtime/evolution metrics, pseudocode, and Mermaid lifecycle flow.
Review highlighted controlled-repository limits, missing public code/data on the arXiv page, LLM validator drift, high evolution false positives, and unresolved semantic information-flow tracking.
Related references covered OpenAI agent skill evals, StackHawk eval harness practice, Red Hat skill security controls, prompt injection, agent benchmarks, and supply-chain security framing.
Markdown is written as h3 sections with tables, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, self-contained TL;DR, concrete benchmark numbers, and no external image URLs.
